notablePrerequisites:
Accomplished Alchemist and Niblis do not have summoning sickness.
You have gained at least four life this turn.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist's second ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Niblis by paying {U} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Niblis' ability, targeting Accomplished Alchemist.
Resolve both Niblis abilities, untapping Niblis and Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.
